App update is unavailable while instance upgrade is scheduled or in progress.

Ending the session only stops the guided upgrade flow you have proceeded through.

  • Any changes like generated tests, skipped records, and store applications updated will remain in the instance.
  • If your instance has already been upgraded, that upgrade will not be rolled back.
  • If your instance has not been upgraded, the upgrade will not proceed.
  • You cannot end the session when the upgrade is in progress.

Once your upgrade is canceled, you will need to start the process from the beginning.
